## About the coach
Oliver Elia studied personal training for four years in Greater Manchester, UK. He then spent four years as a personal trainer for Royal Caribbean on the world's biggest cruise ships (Harmony, Symphony and Oasis of the Seas), before founding Greek God Fitness in Cyprus. He specialises in weight loss, muscle gain, posture alignment and detox.

## Services
- [Personal Training in Limassol](https://greekgodfitness.org/personal-training): private one-to-one sessions with a program designed for each client, for beginners to experienced athletes. Goals include weight loss, muscle gain, posture, strength and overall fitness.
- [Nutrition Plans in Limassol](https://greekgodfitness.org/nutrition): personalised nutrition with The Diet Clinic by Andre Charalambous, a UK-registered clinical dietitian (BSc Nutrition & Dietetics, University of Surrey) specialising in weight loss, hormone and metabolic health.
